title: TollCheck India
sub: For Indian highways: which tolls does the FASTag Annual Pass cover on your trip?
locNone: 📍 Location not available on this device.
coveredQ: Is this toll covered by the FASTag Annual Pass?
storageFull: Phone storage is full: delete older reports first.
reportThanks: Thank you! Your toll report is saved. It will be checked before it is added for everyone.
notFound: We couldn't find "{q}". Please type the nearest city or town instead (for example, the town your village is near).
zeroExtra: ₹0 extra: every toll we know of is covered by the pass
extraUnknown: Extra cost unknown: {n} toll(s) not yet confirmed as covered or not

shareTolls: {km} km, {time}. {n} tolls: {p} you pay, {c} covered by FASTag Annual Pass (uses {t} pass trips).
locDoubt: Location may be wrong in source data
installIos: To install on iPhone: in Safari tap the Share button ⬆︎, then Add to Home Screen.
installOther: To install: open your browser menu ⋮ and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
planningNote: For planning only. Use it to see which tolls are on a route. Drive with Google Maps or Apple Maps: they show live traffic, road closures and construction.
helpCovered: On your road: pass covers it. A national highway or national expressway toll. With the FASTag Annual Pass you pay nothing here; it uses one of your pass trips.
helpNearCovered: Nearby, pass covers it. Not on your road (within 5 km), or an expressway interchange you drive past without stopping. No toll for you on this route.
helpPaid: On your road: you pay. A state, city or private toll. The Annual Pass is not valid here; the normal FASTag charge is taken.
helpNearPaid: Nearby, you pay. A pay toll within 5 km of your road. Not on this route, but you would hit it if you change roads.
helpUnknown: Unknown. The official lists disagree or say nothing about this toll. We are checking these one by one.
helpReported: Reported by you. A toll you added with "Report a toll", waiting for review.
helpTripsTitle: How the Annual Pass counts trips
helpTrip1: Valid for private cars, jeeps and vans, at national highway and national expressway toll plazas only.
helpTrip2: It lasts one year or 200 trips, whichever comes first.
helpTrip3: Normal toll plaza: every crossing is one trip. Going and coming back is two trips.
helpTrip4: Closed expressway (you pay between where you get on and where you get off, e.g. the Delhi–Mumbai Expressway): one entry and exit together is one trip.
helpSrc: Source: IHMCL Annual Pass FAQ (Q11) and the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways.
helpBest: The route with the fewest tolls you pay, then the fewest pass trips used. A faster route wins only if it saves more than 15 minutes.
helpData: The official list of national highway toll plazas (IHMCL, July 2026), the FASTag toll plaza list (NETC, September 2026), OpenStreetMap and GeoNames. Rates are older (2022–2024) and only a guide.
helpNote: This is for planning. Drive with Google Maps or Apple Maps: they know about traffic, closures and construction. If a toll is wrong, tap ＋ Report a toll when you are there.
footerNote: Unconfirmed data. Pass coverage comes from IHMCL's National Highway fee plaza list (July 2026); locations from the NETC FASTag plaza list (Sep 2026) and OpenStreetMap. Rates are 2022–2024 estimates. Check plazas in the Rajmargyatra app before you rely on them.
